description.text:
Flame (焰) is one of the two booster packs of Sword & Shield: Dynamax Clash (极巨争锋), which moved the Simplified Chinese game on to the Sword & Shield series on 19 May 2023, alongside Thunder (雷), a V starter deck and a deck building gift box. It brought Pokémon V and Pokémon VMAX to the game, with a new Triple Rare (RRR) rarity for VMAX cards with a special surface finish and a new textured finish for Double Rare (RR) cards. Shiny (S) and shiny full-art (SSR) cards, last seen in Storming Emergence, came back, and Supporters appeared as rainbow (HR) cards for the first time. Packs held 5 or 25 cards.

Flame holds the Grass, Fire, Darkness and Metal Pokémon and the Trainers that go with them, with Cinderace on its cover: Cinderace V and Cinderace VMAX are in it. Its other VMAX cards include Rillaboom, Centiskorch, Copperajah, Grimmsnarl, Butterfree and Malamar VMAX, and it has Zacian V and Zamazenta V. Its main cards are numbered out of 136; shiny, full-art, shiny full-art, rainbow and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 199.
